reconcile.note: Jamieson, Fausset and Brown distinguish God's essential holiness from the creature's holiness, which comes only through divine sanctification.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells lists Revelation's claim that God alone is holy as clashing with the repeated commands that Israel and the church themselves be holy.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible.

sides.snippet: because it is written, \"You shall be holy; for I am holy.\"
sides.verseText: because it is written, \"You shall be holy; for I am holy.\"

sides.snippet: Who wouldn't fear you, Lord, And glorify your name? For you only are holy.
sides.verseText: Who wouldn't fear you, Lord, And glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.\"
